title: Sunset sail Barcelona’s skyline
text:
Felipe was a fantastic host speaking Spanish & English to the 9 guests who signed up for the sunset sail. 
He served us generous drinks of beer and Cava wine while he told us boat etiquette, and location of ship baño.
The sunset was a bit cloud covered but still Spectacular. Felipe took his time sailing the Barcelona shoreline. You could even see the La Sagrada Família church  in the distance. 
Note: be careful blending wine with Ocean swells…he even had bags for such an occasion. 
Highly recommend this event!
author: Anna_A
